sentences: The Borealis terminal opens a session by sending a SessionRequest message and starting timer T901.
It stops timer T901 as soon as a SessionAccept message arrives.
The terminal was designed for low power consumption.
If no SessionAccept message arrives before timer T901 expires, the terminal repeats the SessionRequest message.

requirements.text: When opening a session, the terminal shall send a SessionRequest message.
When opening a session, the terminal shall start timer T901.
The terminal shall stop timer T901 when a SessionAccept message arrives.
If timer T901 expires before a SessionAccept message arrives, the terminal shall repeat the SessionRequest message.
